claims: Real Oviedo defeated Sevilla with a final score of 1-0 in their La Liga match
The La Liga match was held on April 5, 2026
Federico Viñas scored the crucial goal for Real Oviedo
The match venue was Estadio Carlos Tartiere, Oviedo, Spain
Tanguy Nianzou of Sevilla was shown a red card during the match
The loss kept Sevilla in 17th position
Sevilla was just two points above the relegation zone
Sevilla was in 17th position with 31 points
Real Oviedo was in 20th position with 24 points
